en: A monochrome image showing a narrow old European street beside a large brick Gothic church. In the foreground is an ornate pointed-arch side portal with tracery and a steeply pitched, curved roof. On the right stand several tall, narrow brick townhouses with gabled roofs and many windows, giving a dense medieval or early‑modern urban feel. There is no visible printed caption or text on the front.
